verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair thing to ask of an agent-oriented video platform, but the evidence pack never mentions any Kino SDK or client library. The desktop MCP server belongs to a different story, and being 'built upon Remotion' describes an underlying dependency, not a first-party SDK, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
